Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

complicate verb

also complicate matters, make things difficult, get into a tangle, tangle

classical

Ter. And. 3.5.11: vidēn’ mē cōnsiliīs tuīs miserum impedītum esse? (Lewis & Short)
Ter. And. 3.5.13: rem impedītam, “an intricate affair” (Lewis & Short)

impediō, impedīre, impedīvī, impedītum

verb, fourth conjugation, transitive

entangle; make (a matter) hard to manage

Literally to shackle the feet; hence to entangle a person or an affair so that it is hard to get free. Its commonest sense is plainly “hinder, prevent” (Lewis & Short), so for “complicate” name what is entangled: rem, sē, the plan.

Other words

  • implicō, implicāre, implicāvī (implicuī), implicātum (implicitum) — entangle, involve; implicātus, intricate, complicated

    verb, first conjugation, transitive · also used · classical · Cic. Fin. 3.3: nec in Torquātī sermōne quicquam implicātum aut tortuōsum fuit (Lewis & Short)

    The participle implicātus is the nearest classical word for “complicated”: intricate, involved. The verb more often means to involve someone in something (negōtiīs implicārī, Cic. Off. 2.40, Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • vidēn’ mē cōnsiliīs tuīs miserum impedītum esse?

    don’t you see that your schemes have got poor me into a tangle?Ter. And. 3.5.11 (Lewis & Short)

  • dum aliōs servat, sē impedīvit interim

    while he was saving others, he got himself into a tanglePlaut. Rud. prol. 37 (Lewis & Short)

  • nec in Torquātī sermōne quicquam implicātum aut tortuōsum fuit

    and there was nothing complicated or tortuous in what Torquatus saidCic. Fin. 3.3 (Lewis & Short)

  • Nōlī rem impedīre: satis est difficilis.

    Don’t complicate it: it’s hard enough.composed

See also problem, difficult.

SourcesLewis & Short: impedio · Lewis & Short: implico

Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, with its references, in the house spelling (macrons, consonantal j); they have not been checked against a modern edition.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
